info.title: Smart Competitive Examination Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the Smart Competitive Examination Platform.

Base path: `/api/v1`. All business endpoints are JWT-protected unless explicitly public. Requests may carry an `X-Request-Id` correlation header; if absent, the server generates one and returns it on the response.

Errors use a single standard envelope with a stable `code` per error entry.
